detector-retinaface.title: RetinaFace ResNet-50 face detector
detector-retinaface.summary: RetinaFace with a ResNet-50 backbone, exported for Facetorch face detection.
detector-retinaface.input: RGB image tensor converted to BGR, with spatial dimensions divisible by 32
detector-retinaface.preprocessing: Convert RGB to BGR and subtract channel means [123, 117, 104]. Facetorch performs this preprocessing.
detector-retinaface.output: Sequence of bounding-box regressions [batch, anchors, 4], class probabilities [batch, anchors, 2], and five-point landmark regressions [batch, anchors, 10].
detector-retinaface.dynamic_shapes: Batch 1 for the release contract; height and width are dynamic multiples of 32.

papers.title: RetinaFace: Single-Shot Multi-Level Face Localisation in the Wild

align-synergynet.title: SynergyNet 3D face alignment
align-synergynet.summary: SynergyNet MobileNetV2 checkpoint for approximate 3D facial alignment.
align-synergynet.preprocessing: Resize the Facetorch face crop to 120 by 120; no additional normalization is configured.
align-synergynet.output: 62 values per face: 12 pose, 40 shape, and 10 expression coefficients.

papers.title: Synergy between 3DMM and 3D Landmarks for Accurate 3D Facial Geometry

au-opengraph.title: OpenGraphAU facial action-unit model
au-opengraph.summary: OpenGraphAU Swin-Base stage-one checkpoint producing 41 facial action-unit scores.
au-opengraph.architecture: Swin Transformer Base with graph action-unit head
au-opengraph.preprocessing: Resize to 224 by 224 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
au-opengraph.output: 41 scores in [0, 1]: 27 primary and 14 side-specific facial action units.
au-opengraph.dynamic_shapes: Batch dimension 1 through 64; Facetorch validates the legacy reference per face before batching.

papers.title: Learning Multi-dimensional Edge Feature-based AU Relation Graph for Facial Action Unit Recognition

deepfake-efficientnet-b7.title: EfficientNet-B7 deepfake detector
deepfake-efficientnet-b7.summary: The EfficientNet-B7 checkpoint from Selim Seferbekov's DFDC solution, exported for Facetorch.
deepfake-efficientnet-b7.preprocessing: Resize to 380 by 380 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
deepfake-efficientnet-b7.output: One binary logit per face; Facetorch applies sigmoid and a configurable decision threshold.

embed-resnet50.title: ResNet-50 facial representation model
embed-resnet50.summary: The FLR ResNet-50 VGGFace 1M checkpoint from the Facial Representation Learning project.
embed-resnet50.preprocessing: Resize to 244 by 244 and apply mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.228, 0.224, 0.225], matching the Facetorch contract.
embed-resnet50.output: A normalized 128-dimensional representation and 3,000 projection logits.

papers.title: Pre-training strategies and datasets for facial representation learning

fer-efficientnet-b0.title: EfficientNet-B0 facial-expression classifier
fer-efficientnet-b0.summary: EmotiEffLib EfficientNet-B0 AffectNet checkpoint with seven visible-expression categories.
fer-efficientnet-b0.preprocessing: Resize to 244 by 244 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
fer-efficientnet-b0.output: Seven logits ordered as Anger, Disgust, Fear, Happiness, Neutral, Sadness, Surprise.

papers.title: Classifying Emotions and Engagement in Online Learning Based on a Single Facial Expression Recognition Neural Network

fer-efficientnet-b2.title: EfficientNet-B2 facial-expression classifier
fer-efficientnet-b2.summary: EmotiEffLib EfficientNet-B2 AffectNet checkpoint with eight visible-expression categories.
fer-efficientnet-b2.preprocessing: Resize to 260 by 260 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
fer-efficientnet-b2.output: Eight logits ordered as Anger, Contempt, Disgust, Fear, Happiness, Neutral, Sadness, Surprise.

papers.title: Classifying Emotions and Engagement in Online Learning Based on a Single Facial Expression Recognition Neural Network

va-elim.title: ELIM valence-arousal model
va-elim.summary: The second ELIM demo checkpoint set, exported for continuous valence and arousal estimation.
va-elim.architecture: ELIM modified AlexNet encoder, regressor, and task header
va-elim.preprocessing: Resize to 224 by 224 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225].
va-elim.output: Two values ordered as valence and arousal.

papers.title: Optimal Transport-based Identity Matching for Identity-invariant Facial Expression Recognition

verify-adaface.title: AdaFace IR-101 WebFace12M verifier
verify-adaface.summary: AdaFace IR-101 checkpoint trained on WebFace12M and exported for face-similarity research.
verify-adaface.preprocessing: Resize to 112 by 112, convert RGB to BGR, then normalize with mean and standard deviation [0.5, 0.5, 0.5].
verify-adaface.output: A normalized 512-dimensional embedding and one pre-normalization feature norm per face.

papers.title: AdaFace: Quality Adaptive Margin for Face Recognition

verify-magface.title: MagFace plus UNPG ResNet-100 verifier
verify-magface.summary: MagFace ResNet-100 trained with Unified Negative Pair Generation and exported for face-similarity research.
verify-magface.preprocessing: Resize to 112 by 112 and apply ImageNet mean [0.485, 0.456, 0.406] and standard deviation [0.229, 0.224, 0.225], matching the Facetorch contract.

papers.title: Unified Negative Pair Generation toward Well-discriminative Feature Space for Face Recognition
MagFace: A Universal Representation for Face Recognition and Quality Assessment
